verdict.rationale: Docs show strong support for cloud/background agent workflows (web sessions, long-running tasks, scheduled runs, PR creation with tests written and verified) that let a cloud agent build and test a feature and hand off a PR for review, e.g. docs-14/26/13/10/2/3. However, there's no explicit 'demo' artifact generation, and community reports describe unreliable self-verification and degrading output quality, undercutting confidence in autonomous end-to-end delivery.
